name: tikker-language-server
description: Language server for Tikker (.tkr): diagnostics, colors, hover, go-to-definition, completion
author: voidfemme

scripts.build: tsc -p . && esbuild build/server.js build/cli.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --outdir=dist --log-level=warning && cp node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.wasm dist/
